services.name: Raft rentals
services.desc: Rafts are 14 ft self bailer rafts that come with Trailer and 2 inch hitch and a rowing frame and oars. Rafts are comfortable for up to 5 to 6 adults. Most popular float is from skilak lake down the kenai river to Bings landing, this is an 11 mile float with a one mile row across a portion of the Skilak lake and then entering the RIver. This trip includes our shuttle services with pickup and drop off for $275.00. Or you can take the raft and trailer with you behind your own vehicle if you have a 2 inch ball on your rig for $200.00 per day. This makes you mobile to go where you want.
